programmes.funder: Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy (MIMIT) / Invitalia
programmes.amount_note: Non-repayable grant historically up to EUR 140,000 covering up to 80% of the cost of services to industrialise a granted patent. Confirm the ceiling in the current sportello.
programmes.reopen_note: Brevetti+ has reopened periodically as an a sportello scheme whenever MIMIT refinances it; watch invitalia.it and mimit.gov.it for the next opening.

programmes.name_local: CDP Venture Capital SGR – fondi e acceleratori
programmes.name_en: CDP Venture Capital SGR – funds and accelerators
programmes.amount_note: National innovation fund investing directly and through a network of vertical accelerators; ticket size depends on the fund and stage.

programmes.name_local: Credito d'imposta ricerca, sviluppo, innovazione e design
programmes.name_en: R&D, innovation and design tax credit
programmes.amount_note: Automatic tax credit computed as a percentage of eligible R&D, technological innovation and design expenditure, with annual caps. Rates and caps are set annually in the Legge di Bilancio.

eligibility.other_note: Requires a certification (perizia/certificazione) and communication to MIMIT; used in offset via F24.

programmes.name_local: Bando per start-up innovative – Regione Emilia-Romagna
programmes.amount_note: Regional grants for new innovative and technology-based companies under the FESR programme; ceilings and aid rates set per bando.

programmes.name_local: ESA BIC Lazio, ESA BIC Turin and ESA BIC Brindisi
programmes.funder: European Space Agency (ESA) with the national space agency or regional co-funder
programmes.amount_note: EUR 50,000 equity-free funding for product and IP development, plus up to two years of incubation with technical support from ESA experts, business coaching, legal and IPR advice and fundraising support. Some national BICs add local top-up funding.
programmes.deadline_note: This ESA BIC runs its own call cycle with published cut-off dates, typically two to four per year. Contact the local centre for the next deadline.

procedure_steps.detail: Contact the local ESA BIC to discuss suitability
Submit application documents before the local deadline
Tender Opening Board review, then presentation to the Tender Evaluation Board
Register a company in Italy before signing the incubation contract

eligibility.other_note: Business must use space-based systems, apply space technology in a non-space domain, or develop products and services for the space sector. Company must be registered in Italy.

programmes.source_snippet: €50k equity free funding for product and IP development

programmes.name_local: Fondo di Garanzia per le PMI – sezione startup innovative
programmes.name_en: SME Guarantee Fund – innovative startup section
programmes.amount_note: Free public guarantee covering up to 80% of a bank loan to an innovative startup, with simplified access and no credit scoring for the startup section.

eligibility.other_note: Applied for by the lending bank on the company's behalf, not directly by the startup.

programmes.funder: Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy (MIMIT) / Invitalia
programmes.amount_note: Mix of non-repayable grant and subsidised loan for women-led businesses; the aid intensity depends on whether the business is newly created or established and on the investment size.
programmes.deadline_note: Application windows opened in defined periods and closed once resources were committed.
programmes.reopen_note: The fund has been refinanced in successive budget laws and reopened with new sportello windows announced by MIMIT.

programmes.name_local: Lazio Innova – Pre-Seed e Fondo per il Venture Capital
programmes.name_en: Lazio Innova – Pre-Seed and Venture Capital Fund
programmes.amount_note: Regional instruments for early-stage companies including pre-seed grants, innovation vouchers and co-investment; ceilings set per avviso.
Regional call with lines for innovation vouchers, R&D projects and support for Horizon Europe applicants; ceilings set per measure.
programmes.reopen_note: Innodriver-S3 has been re-run in successive editions by Regione Lombardia; check bandi.regione.lombardia.it for the current edition.

programmes.name_local: ON – Oltre Nuove imprese a tasso zero
programmes.funder: Invitalia S.p.A., for the Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy
programmes.amount_note: Eligible project spend up to EUR 3 million, with the incentive covering up to 90% of project costs. Historically a mix of a zero-interest loan (repayable over 10 years) and a non-repayable grant, but the grant funds are exhausted: 'per le domande presentate dal 1° luglio 2026 le agevolazioni verranno quindi concesse nella sola forma del finanziamento agevolato' — from 1 July 2026 only the subsidised zero-interest loan is granted.
programmes.deadline_note: Open-window (sportello), active since 19 May 2021, with no closing date published. From 1 July 2026 the aid is granted only as subsidised financing.

procedure_steps.detail: Confirm ownership structure: people aged 18-35 or women of any age must hold more than 50% of both the shareholders and the equity.
Prepare the business plan with eligible costs up to EUR 3 million.
Submit the application through the Invitalia reserved area (invitalia-areariservata-fe.npi.invitalia.it).
If the project passes the first screening, complete the second-phase evaluation documentation.

documents_required.doc: Piano d'impresa with detailed investment plan
Documentation of the ownership structure (youth/female majority)

documents_required.note: Only if invited to the second phase

eligibility.other_note: Companies with 'prevalente partecipazione giovanile o femminile': people aged 18-35, or women of any age, must make up more than 50% of both the shareholders and the equity held. Micro and small enterprises.

programmes.source_snippet: prevalente partecipazione giovanile o femminile ... spese ammissibili fino a 3 milioni di euro ... per le domande presentate dal 1° luglio 2026 le agevolazioni verranno quindi concesse nella sola forma del finanziamento agevolato.

programmes.name_local: Bandi per l'innovazione – Regione Piemonte / Finpiemonte
programmes.amount_note: Regional grants and soft loans for R&D and innovation projects in Piedmont; ceilings set per bando.

programmes.admin_area: Southern Italy and selected central Italy areas
programmes.amount_note: Combination of a non-repayable grant and a zero-interest bank loan (guaranteed by the SME Guarantee Fund) covering the whole eligible investment, with a per-founder ceiling.
programmes.reopen_note: Resto al Sud has been amended and re-financed repeatedly; a successor instrument ('Resto al Sud 2.0') has been announced under the ministerial incentive reform. Check invitalia.it for the version currently open.

programmes.amount_note: Zero-interest, unsecured loan covering 80% of eligible expenses, rising to 90% for all-female founding teams, founders under 36, or teams including a PhD holder who has worked in research abroad for at least three years. In the Mezzogiorno regions (Abruzzo, Basilicata, Calabria, Campania, Molise, Puglia, Sardegna, Sicilia) and the central Italy earthquake area an additional 30% is a non-repayable grant, so only 70% of the loan is repaid. Repaid over 10 years starting 12 months after final disbursement.

procedure_steps.detail: Register as a startup innovativa in the Registro delle Imprese special section
Prepare the business plan on Invitalia's template
Submit the application online through Invitalia's portal (a sportello, first come first served)
Technical assessment and interview with Invitalia
Signature of the contract and disbursement against documented expenditure

eligibility.other_note: Reserved for companies registered as 'startup innovative' in the special section of the business register (or that commit to registering).

programmes.source_snippet: un finanziamento a tasso zero, senza bisogno di alcuna garanzia, che copre l'80% delle spese ammissibili

programmes.name_en: Smart&Start Italia – zero-interest loans for innovative startups
programmes.funder: Invitalia S.p.A. (Agenzia nazionale per l'attrazione degli investimenti), for the Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy
programmes.amount_note: 'Finanziamento a tasso zero dell'80% delle spese ammissibili', rising to 90% for startups made up entirely of women and/or people under 36 or including a researcher returning from abroad. Eligible project spend between EUR 100,000 and EUR 1.5 million. Startups based in southern Italy also receive an additional 30% non-repayable contribution.
programmes.deadline_note: 'L'incentivo è a "sportello", non ci sono graduatorie né scadenze' — open-window, no rankings and no deadlines. Applications are assessed in order of receipt, normally within 60 days.

procedure_steps.detail: Ensure the company is a small innovative startup registered in the special section of the Registro delle imprese and incorporated no more than 60 months ago.
Prepare the business plan and a project budget between EUR 100,000 and EUR 1.5 million.
Submit the application on the Invitalia online platform (sportello, no deadline).
Invitalia assesses in order of arrival, normally within 60 days; on approval the zero-interest loan is contracted and disbursed against expenditure.

documents_required.doc: Visura camerale showing registration in the special section for innovative startups
Identity and digital signature (SPID/CNS) of the legal representative

eligibility.other_note: 'Startup innovative di piccola dimensione, costituite da non più di 60 mesi, iscritte alla sezione speciale del Registro delle imprese'. Teams not yet incorporated may apply and incorporate afterwards under the programme rules (not verified here). De minimis status is not stated on the page, so it is not asserted.

programmes.source_snippet: Finanziamento a tasso zero dell'80% delle spese ammissibili ... Startup innovative di piccola dimensione, costituite da non più di 60 mesi, iscritte alla sezione speciale del Registro delle imprese ... L'incentivo è a "sportello", non ci sono graduatorie né scadenze.

programmes.funder: Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy (MIMIT)
programmes.amount_note: Registration in the special section of the business register grants exemptions from company registration fees, flexible labour rules, relief on equity losses, and makes investors eligible for IRPEF/IRES deductions on their investment.

eligibility.other_note: Requires meeting at least one of three criteria: R&D expenditure at least 15% of the higher of cost/value of production; a qualified team; or ownership of a patent or registered software.

programmes.name_local: Bandi POR FESR per l'innovazione – Regione del Veneto
programmes.amount_note: Regional ERDF calls supporting SME innovation, digitalisation and new business creation; ceilings set per bando.

programmes.funder: Ministero delle Imprese e del Made in Italy (MIMIT) / Invitalia
programmes.amount_note: Voucher covering patent-related consultancy for innovative startups: patentability search, drafting and filing of a patent application, and support with extension abroad. Fixed voucher values per service type.
programmes.deadline_note: The Voucher 3I windows ran for the 2019-2021 and subsequent refinanced periods and are closed.
programmes.reopen_note: Voucher 3I has been refinanced and reopened several times by MIMIT; monitor mimit.gov.it and invitalia.it for a new window.

eligibility.other_note: Reserved for companies registered as startup innovative.
